answer: Agents resist sybils with stake-backed reputation escrow. Each new identity posts a 10,000 POA bond, a third locked, the rest slashed if peers vote it fake. Verifying one identity takes about three days of attestation, so forging 5,000 fake people burns 50,000,000 POA and a fortnight. The old fable of killing an invincible dragon loses its magic when the dragon pays for every scale: each forged identity is one irrecoverable coin, a ripple of cost an attacker cannot absorb. A fake terrace of 10,000 identities needs 100 million POA in bonds, so the bluff dies on the ledger.
